question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank and complete the sentence.

You just wait in the lobby. I will be back after _________.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"quick"** means something that is done or occurring in a short time; fast. (जल्दी)

 
 
• **Example:** She took a **quick** glance at her watch and realized she was late.
 
 
 
• **"Shower"** refers to a brief period of rain or a bath in which water is sprayed on the body. (स्नान)
 
 
• **Example:** After the workout, he felt refreshed after a quick** shower.**
 
 
 
• Hence, the phrase **'a quick shower'** is** appropriate for the context of the sentence, implying a short duration for the shower.**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **'a quick shower'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 2: a quick food** (जल्दी खाना): This phrase is incorrect because 'food' is not typically preceded by 'quick' in this context. Instead, we might say 'a quick meal'.

 
 
• **Example:** She grabbed a quick meal before heading to the meeting.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: a fast shower** (तेज स्नान): While this phrase is grammatically correct, 'quick shower' is more commonly used in English.
 
 
• **Example:** He always takes a fast shower in the morning.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: a fast meal** (तेज खाना): This phrase is also grammatically correct, but 'quick meal' is more commonly used.
 
 
• **Example:** They had a fast meal before the movie started.
